title: Nurse Scheduling with State-of-the Art Open-Source Tools.
problem: Nurse scheduling is an NP-hard and highly context-dependent problem that remains unsolved, requiring guidance for practical implementation without costly tools.
contribution: The paper demonstrates the effectiveness of using open-source tools like OMPR and DEAP for nurse scheduling, providing a valuable alternative to commercial products.
method: A mathematical model is combined with a genetic algorithm.
data_setup: A Swiss hospital planning a new nurse training station with completed capacity planning and known constraints.
results: The solutions indicate that actual capacity planning together with hard constraints cannot lead to valid staff schedules, necessitating more degrees of freedom.
